The experimental evidence demonstrates a classic 'lost update' concurrency bug in a shared counter scenario. Before the fix, the model check confirmed a violation where two workers read the counter (value 0), both incremented locally, and subsequently wrote back the same value (1), resulting in a final counter value of 1 instead of the expected 2. The proposed repair—protecting the entire read-modify-write operation with a single lock—successfully eliminated the violation in the model check. Real-world testing using an instrumented counter fixture confirmed this fix, showing the counter correctly reaching 2 after the lock was applied.
